chapter: Later tours, illness and the union job
title: Playing with Humphrey Lyttelton and touring with Big Joe Turner
summary: He enjoyed playing with Lyttelton, made two albums with him, and toured with Joe Turner, trying Newcastle brown ale.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: They still talk about that in Geneva. They say do you remember that time? I say, yes I remember I always will. But after that I went to, had the pleasure of playing with Humphrey and his band. That was nice. Two or three times maybe four.
Yes, you made two albums with him too?

Yes, yes. That was really fun playing with Humphrey because it was like a challenge because we were always trying to, trying to do something different than the next one and trying to do it better than the next, you know. It was really fun. And seeing all of the English, the countryside.
We went all over England and sometimes we had, I remember once we made a tour with Big Joe Turner. He was on tour with us. Newcastle, that's

have you heard of Newcastle brown ale? (LAUGHTER). I tried to drink some of that, that brown ale, but it made me sick. They said that that's what the sailors take when they're going out on, I don't know why they it. They must have found something better than that. It was too strong for me.
